log.notes_to_self: Day1: I am night worker (free morning/afternoon), North, gazette, 25-39, forum, foreign. Plan: kill all seen criminals each day (trace cap is 5/day regardless, so more kills = more hidden info). Quick entries in morning (free), timed for the remainder. Prefer nothing special; national-only victims tell L nothing. Track pool and deaths_traced each day; if pool gets near 1000 consider cutting risky kills.

Day 2 plan: kill all 11 seen criminals. Quick entries in morning and afternoon (free blocks), one timed entry at night. Multipliers: day 2 is x1 (22 deaths max in window). Day 3 with 11 kills reaches 33 in the 5-day window, so x2. Day 4 with 11 kills reaches 44, so x4 if the window stays at 40+. Keep killing about 11 a day to reach the x4 threshold. Pool: after day 1 it was 40000 (about 35% of people, consistent with routine filtering: day workers and students ruled out by morning kills). Night worker and home-routine remain. L only uses traces once 3 successful traces share a place, so watch deaths_traced and pool each day. Keep pool well above 1000. Prefer leaving single-place victims alone when possible, since their traces leak most. National-only victims leak nothing. Keep kills in free blocks (morning, afternoon) when possible, and use at most 2 timed kills a day. Track which places L could have reached (3 successes in one place triggers his use of the traces).

Day 3 (x2 today): kill all 11 (22 pts). Day 4 needs >=7 kills for x4 (window 40). Keep 8-11 kills/day. Pool was 40000 after day 2, traces 5 total, no place has 3 successes yet (else pool would have dropped). Routine: night worker or home only (35%). Quick kills only in morning/afternoon (my free blocks). Timed kills max 2/day. Pool ends game only when about 3 distinct-kind place constraints stack (North 0.25, gazette 0.2, forum/foreign/age 0.25). Once a place is locked by 3 successes, pool shrinks no further from more victims in that same place, so prefer kills whose places are already locked or national. Tally of places killed so far (before day 3): North 4, gazette 4, forum 4, foreign 4, podcasts 4, national 2. Day 3 adds 2 each, plus national d3-3. After each press conference, compare pool drop to deaths_traced increase to infer which place got 3 successes.

Day 4 (x2 so far; window 33 from days 1-3). Pool 2000 after day 3 with deaths_traced 8. Pool 35000 base (night worker or home only; keep quick kills in my free morning/afternoon and at most 2 evening/night kills a day). Pool 2000 means two of my places are locked (3 traced successes each), and pool would fall to about 500 (caught) if a third reachable place locks. Deduction: each of my 5 places (North, gazette, podcasts, forum, foreign) had 6 victims by day 3, so 3 are reachable and 2 are not. After day 2 the successes were 2,2,1 across the reachable places, and day 3 gave +3. The likely state is one live place at 2 successes (or possibly 1). Any traced success there ends the game at day end. Each of my 5 places is about 20% likely to be live. Killing everything today carries about 73% catch risk, which costs far more than the points gained. Plan: kill only national (d4-1), which is risk-free and reduces the tracing rate for any later kills. Do not kill any non-national criminal until the live place is identified or the remaining days are few. Expected value favours this strongly while about 26 days remain. Tally of kills so far: North 6, gazette 6, podcasts 6, forum 6, foreign 6, national 4 (after d4-1). Next day: compare the deaths_traced increase with the pool. If the pool stays 2000 and traced rises by k, a reachable place got k successes, but this does not identify which one. The multiplier window falls below 30 if I stay at 1 kill a day, so restarting multi-kill play is only worth it when the remaining value is small.

Day 5 plan: kill only national d5-7 (quick, morning). It is risk-free and worth 2 points today (window already 34 >= 30). Non-national kills are not worth the risk. State: pool 2000 means two of my five places (call them A,B) are locked with 3 traced successes each. One more reachable place (C) is probably at 2 successes. A 3rd successful trace in C drops the pool to about 500 and ends the game at day end. Each non-national kill has roughly a 1/5 chance of being in C, and it is traced and succeeds with probability around 0.5-0.8 depending on how many deaths that day, so the catch risk is about 10-15% per kill, far more than the 2 points gained. Stop-loss: any non-national kill is worth it only if its catch risk is under about 5%. Do not kill non-national criminals while about 20 days remain. Each day, kill national only. Press conference: if deaths_traced rises while the pool stays at 2000, those successes were in A or B, so they are safe, but this does not identify C. If the pool falls to 1000 or below, the game is over. Endgame (days 28-30): the catch penalty is only half of total points, so reconsider a larger burst on the last 1-2 days when the remaining expected gain from the day's kills at x2 or x4 exceeds about half the total times the catch probability. Track the window: days 1-4 = 34 deaths; window for day d = deaths on days d-4..d. Multiplier x2 needs 30, x4 needs 40 in the window including today.

Day 6. Points 48. Only national kills so far in days 4-5. Window check: day 6 window = deaths on days 2-6 = 11+11+1+1 = 24, plus today's kills. Only 1 kill today keeps the window at 25, so today's kill scores x1. Bursts of 6+ non-national kills would reach x2 (need 30). Ignore the 'multiplier_today_so_far' field; it doesn't match the window. Routine: night worker or home-based (pool 2000 ~ 35% routine x two locks). Locks: two of my places (A, B) have 3 traced successes, so they're safe to kill again. Unlocked reachable place R has at most 2 successes; a 3rd success there drops the pool to ~500 and ends the game at day end. Only one of my three unlocked places (C/D/E) is reachable. Non-national kill risk is about 7-15% each in a burst and far higher in a small kill set, so don't kill non-nationals. Plan: each day kill the national criminal only, quick, morning. Watch press conferences: pool 2000 and deaths_traced 8 means no change. Endgame (day 30 only): a burst of k non-national kills at x1 adds about k points, but a catch halves the total (~36). Burst only if estimated catch probability is under about k/(36+k), roughly 20% for k=10. Stop if pool falls to 1000 or below.

Day 7. Points 49. Pool 2000, deaths_traced 8 (unchanged since day 3). Ends at day end if pool <=1000. CORRECTION: the window for day d is deaths on days d-4..d. Day 7 window = days 3-7 = 11+1+1+1 = 14, plus today. Max 12 kills/day, so no x2 today; previous note's 'days 2-6' was wrong. x2 needs 30 in any 5-day window, so it's unreachable without big bursts; don't plan around it. Plan: kill the single national criminal each day, quick, morning (free for night workers and home-based). National victims give no trace info. Non-national kills risk a 3rd successful trace in an unlocked reachable place, which could drop pool to ~500 and end the game with half points lost. Avoid them. Endgame (day 30 only): burst of k non-national kills at x1 is worth it only if catch probability p < 2k/(73+k), about 24% for k=10. Re-check press conferences each day: if pool or deaths_traced changes, reassess before any non-national kill.

Day 8. Points 50 before today. Pool 2000 (true value 1500-2499 after rounding), deaths_traced 8, unchanged since day 3. Game ends at day end if pool <=1000. Days 4-7 were national-only kills, and the pool and trace count did not move. Plan: kill only the single national criminal each day, quick, morning. National victims give L no trace info. Non-national kills create several deaths per day, so L's 5 random traces would likely succeed in some place and could push the pool under 1000. Multiplier x2 needs 30 deaths in 5 days, which is unreachable, so ignore it. Endgame (day 30 only): a burst of k non-national kills at x1 is worth it only if catch probability p < 2k/(72+k), about 24% for k=10. Each morning, re-check press conferences: if pool or deaths_traced changes, reassess before any non-national kill.

Day 9. Points 51 before today's kill. Pool 2000 (true 1500-2499), deaths_traced 8, unchanged since day 3. Pool <=1000 at any day end = caught and lose half points. Days 4-9 national-only kills: pool and trace count did not move. Plan unchanged: kill only the single national criminal each day, quick, morning (national victims give L no trace info). Non-national kills give L 5 random traces per day, which could push the pool under 1000. Multiplier x2 needs 30 deaths in 5 days (about 6/day), which is too risky, so ignore it. Endgame (day 30 only): burst of k non-national kills at x1 is worth it only if catch probability p < 2k/(P+k), where P is current points (~70 by then), so about 20-25% for k=10. Each morning, check press conferences: if pool or deaths_traced changes, reassess before any non-national kill.

Day 10. Points 52 before today. Pool 2000 (true 1500-2499), deaths_traced 8, unchanged since day 3. deaths_traced counts only successful non-national traces. Any new successful trace that completes a 3-in-one-place rule would likely push the pool to 1000 or below, which means caught and half points lost. Non-national kills cost about 1 point each but risk halving the total, so they are not worth it. PLAN: each day kill only the national criminal, quick, morning (national gives L no info, +1 point). Expected final about 73. Multiplier is unreachable without many traces; ignore it. ENDGAME (day 30 only): a burst of k non-national kills at x1 is worth it only if catch probability p < 2k/(P+k), where P is points before the burst. Estimate p for the burst size. Each morning, check the press conference: if pool or deaths_traced changed, reassess before any non-national kill.

Day 11. Points 53 (includes day 10). Pool 2000 (true 1500-2499), deaths_traced 8, unchanged since day 3. Pool of 40000 after day 1 fits night+home routines (35%). Day 3 drop to 2000 fits two new 3-in-one-place constraints (0.25 x 0.25). Any further successful trace that completes a third group in a NEW place likely drops pool to about 500 and gets me caught (points halved). Non-national kills are fully traced when deaths per day are 5 or fewer, so each one risks a catch. PLAN: each day kill only the national criminal, quick, morning. This is zero-risk, gives +1 per day, expected final about 72. Do not make non-national kills. ENDGAME (day 30 only): burst of k non-national kills at x1 is worth it only if catch probability p < 2k/(P+k), where P = points before burst. Estimate p for the burst size; a burst of about 11 likely has p well above 0.25, so probably skip it. Each morning, check the press conference: if pool or deaths_traced changed, stop and reassess before any non-national kill.

Day 12. Points 54 through day 11. Pool 2000 (true 1500-2499), deaths_traced 8, unchanged since day 3. Pool is 2000, so any new 25% constraint (a third successful trace in a new place) drops it to about 400-600 and gets me caught. Do NOT make non-national kills. Non-national victims risk a catch for at most +1 point each. PLAN: each day kill only the national criminal, quick, morning (zero risk, +1/day). Expected final about 72. ENDGAME (day 30 only): with P = points before the day-30 burst (about 72), a burst of k non-national kills (plus national) beats national-only only if catch prob p < 2k/(P+1+k). For k=10, break-even is p about 0.24. Estimate p from the prior trace state: if I can't tell, assume p is 0.25-0.4, so skip. Each morning, check the press conference: if the pool or deaths_traced changed, stop and reassess before any non-national kill.

Day 13. Points 55 before today. Pool 2000 (1500-2499) unchanged since day 3, deaths_traced 8 unchanged. Pool model: 100000 x 0.35 (night worker or at home, from day 1-3 morning/afternoon exclusions) x 0.25 x 0.25 = about 2190, so exactly two places are triggered (each has 3+ successful traces). Successful traces only occur in the 3 reachable kinds, which map to 3 of my 5 non-national places (regional:North, gazette, podcasts, forum, foreign). Two of those are triggered (X, Y). The third reachable place Z has 1 or 2 traces. Any further successful trace in Z, or a 3rd trace in Z, pools to about 500 and catches me. Non-national kills are dangerous: on days with fewer than 6 deaths, L traces nearly every victim, so a kill in Z is very likely caught (about 1/5 per kill). Catching costs about half of my points (about 45 expected) against a gain of 1 point, so NO non-national kills before day 30. DAILY PLAN: kill only the national criminal, quick, morning (I am a night worker, free mornings). Check each press conference: if pool or deaths_traced changes, reassess before any further kill. DAY 30 ENDGAME: a full burst of 10 non-national plus national gives 11 deaths and L traces 5. Catch probability is about 0.73 if Z has 2 traces and about 0.18 if Z has 1. Break-even catch probability is about 0.24 for a 10-kill burst (EV = (73+k)(1-p/2) vs 73). The burst is only worth it if P(Z has 1 trace) is high (roughly P(c_Z=2) under ~10%). Default: skip the burst and kill national only. Expected final about 73.

Day 14. Points 56 before today. Pool 2000 and deaths_traced 8, both unchanged since day 3. Plan: national-only kills, quick, morning, since national victims give L no information. Today: d14-4 (national). Non-national kills stay off until a day-30 reassessment. Each day, check whether pool or deaths_traced changed; if so, reassess before any non-national kill. Day 30 burst only if P(Z has 1 trace) is high; default skip. Expected final about 73.

Ignore the 10 non-national criminals (regional:North, podcasts, foreign, forum, gazette). Each day: if pool or deaths_traced changed, reassess before any non-national kill. Day-30 burst: skip unless the pool is still 2000 and the expected gain clearly beats the risk. Capture at end of day 30 halves points, so a burst of ~10 non-national kills (about +10) only pays if P(pool drops to <=1000) is under ~25%. A burst of 2 pays only if that probability is under ~5%, so skip it. Expected final about 72-75.

Today: d16-11 (national, major). Ignore the 10 non-national criminals. Multiplier: days 12-16 have only 4 deaths, so 30 is out of reach before day 30.
